nusmp.skill.book_recombination.descripti: Henry Legolant's attribute: the magic house is taken apart and put back together at your call - walls, swapped rooms, a drill of mana, and the Raging Black Bull, a house with legs, horns and cannons. Cast it and the house is worn as armour: a roof-tile cap, a door on your chest, the house itself on your back with smoke rising. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.mana_corks: Mana Corkscrew - a drill of compressed mana spirals out and bores through a line, pushing back everything it hits. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.bulwark: Recombination: Bulwark - the magic house folds a ring of walls round you for ten seconds, with a room standing at each corner, and you gain Absorption.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.room_swap: Recombination: Room Swap - two rooms change places: you and the target swap positions, a room rises at each place and the target is slowed for a second.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.raging_bla: The Raging Black Bull - the magic house rebuilds itself into a bull that follows you, rams the nearest foe and fires its cannons for a minute. It grows with your EP. (Henry Legolant's grimoire only.)
nusmp.page.book_recombination.house_armo: House Armour - the magic house worn as armour for twenty seconds: eleven pieces forge in on your body, the house stands on your back, and a quarter of every blow (more with EP, at most 38 percent) is taken off. Resistance I.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.room_rebui: Recombination: Room Rebuild - as the house mends itself, you and your allies within seven blocks are healed and regenerate; a room rises at your side.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.ultra_gian: Ultra Giant Bull - the Compound spell: your Raging Black Bull grows one and a half times, fires four cannons at a time and rams harder for twenty seconds. The Bull must already stand.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.plank_snar: Recombination: Plank Snare - boards close round a foe and hold it for three seconds, then it takes a blow. Hard control: shares the twelve-second lock, a boss is held for a quarter as long.
